justification: The only overlap is the most generic: both surfaces include human figures with raised arms and animals shown in profile, which any tradition could produce independently. A shows a single large, naturalistically modelled winged figure in bust-length profile with detailed beard, headdress and feathered wing, while B is a scattered field of tiny schematic stick-figures, quadrupeds and repeated crewed boats with no dominant figure, no wings, and no shared relationships or arrangement.
